snippet.title: Don't Splat! – Play Together Trailer | Online Co-op, Couch Co-op & Versus up to 4v4
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5426960/Dont_Splat/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch2026&utm_content=fragman2

Your friends. A wall full of holes. No time to argue about who goes where.

Don't Splat! is a co-op party game for 1–4 players, and this trailer is all about playing together:

- Online co-op: quick match with other players or a room with your friends
- Couch co-op: 2 to 4 players on one screen, keyboard or controller
- Versus: 1v1 up to 4v4. Splat their screen, hide their walls, shake them up
- Four elemental powers: fire, earth, air and water
- Leaderboards, so your group can prove it's the best one

Coming soon to Steam.

Music: "Happy Rock" by Alex_Besss (Pixabay)
Postante Studio · press@postante.com
